memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'I am your God. I brought you out of Egypt.'

sequence.prompt: What happened at the mountain? Put it in order.

items.label: God's people camped at the mountain
God came down in cloud and fire
God said, 'I brought you out of Egypt'
Then God gave His good commands

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.left: the order God did it in

pairs.right: A gift showing how to love

application.question: God rescued His people before He asked them for anything. Which command is hardest for you?
application.followUp: You do not obey God to make Him love you — He rescued you first. You obey Him because He already does.
